newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican bolsa suspends floor trading due to fire.
newsitem.headline: Mexican bolsa suspends floor trading due to fire.

text.p: The Mexican stock exchange said a small electrical fire following the close of trade on Thursday will force floor trading to be suspended on Friday, leaving only electronic trading.

"All trading on the BMV (Mexican Stock Exchange) will be done from the offices of brokerage houses through terminals linked to the electronic systems BMV-Sentra Capitales and BMV-Sentra Titulos de Deuda," the stock exchange said in a news release on Thursday night.
The electrical fire in the basement broke out shortly after the close of trade at 3 p.m. (2000 GMT), forcing the evacuation of exchange employees and floor traders.
